items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And then she called me and him, Buck and Jeff.

ctx.x: Ask him if he knew Big Cornish.
Did you know Corny? Who? Big Corny? He's a big little Big Corny. He was another chicken one too. He was about six feet tall too. He was tall. And then she called me and him, Buck and Jeff.
Tell him I heard he had a fight with Corny.
